tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The ground for every layout.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Figure plates and table bodies that sit slightly forward of the page. Never as a card with a shadow.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Code blocks, Remark backgrounds, hover rows. The only filled surface besides the page.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings, booktabs rules. Reads on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and accent-soft (12:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Abstracts, secondary prose, table headers. 6.3:1 or better on every paper surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Metadata only: dates, roles, figure numbers, tag text. 4.5:1 or better on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk, accent-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: section dividers, inner table rules, figure frames. 1px only. Never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Borders that must be seen: Tag outlines, input borders. 3:1 or better on paper in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ink blue. Links, figure and table labels, equation numbers, the focus ring. Text on paper surfaces at 6.7:1 or better. Use sparingly: one or two marks per screen.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Text selection, a highlighted table row, the background of a Remark of kind Result.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text set on a solid accent fill (rare: a selected Tag). 8.4:1 or better in both themes.

families.serif: "EB Garamond", "Latin Modern Roman", Garamond, Georgia, serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The name on the PageHeader. Once per site.

styles.name: subsection
styles.usage: Subsections. Italic, as a textbook sets them.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The discharge supply regulates anode current to within two percent across the throttling range.
styles.usage: All running prose. Garamond sets small, so 19px is the floor for body.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Measured efficiency versus output power at 300 V input.
styles.usage: Figure and table captions, after the label.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: Tag text, figure numbers in mono contexts, metadata rows.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers in SpecTable cells, inline values, code.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, gap between tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding, caption offset from figure.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones; Remark padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between paragraphs and blocks within a section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between ProjectEntry items; space above a figure.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Space above a SectionHeading.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of page to PageHeader; end of page.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tables, rules, figures. The default: this system is square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Tags and inline code.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Remark blocks and code blocks only.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the text column (about 70 characters of body).

tokens.name: measure-wide
tokens.usage: Max width for wide figures and SpecTables that break out of the text column.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every decorative rule.

tokens.name: rule-heavy
tokens.usage: Booktabs top and bottom rules on SpecTable.
